capabilities: : Display title matches in a dedicated section
: Rank results based on match position
intentEvidence: Obsidian's search can sort by date, modification time, or name — but there is no "scan every title first, then look inside the notes" option.
problem: Standard Obsidian search often buries title matches under body content results, making it difficult to quickly find notes based solely on their filename.
summary: A search enhancement that prioritizes matching note titles before executing the core full-text search, providing a dedicated title-matching pass.
